Phase 6: after fixing test-gate-cache-lib.sh's ROOT resolution (Phase 2), the deployed-path run still showed 1 failure (case11, previously masked by the CANNOT_COMPUTE sentinel that the wrong ROOT produced for ALL four failing cases). Root cause: gate_cache_libdir_digest($root) resolves component 3 source-store-first (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib), falling back to .claude/scripts/lib only when the source-store dir is absent -- same convention as gate_cache_resolve_verify_deploy/gate_cache_resolve_ref in the same library. Case11 perturbed $CORE_DIR/lib (invocation-path dependent: the deployed copy when run deployed), which is NOT what the digest function actually hashes in a repo that owns the source store, so perturbing it never changed the digest and the assertion failed for an unrelated reason. Fixed by having the test resolve the SAME directory the SUT resolves (source-store-first, deployed-fallback) before picking a file to perturb. This is a second, independently pre-existing test-side defect that the primary walk-up-depth fix unmasked, matching the task's own 'quiet failure, new unrelated cause' pattern one layer deeper. Both invocation paths now report 28 passed, 0 failed.
